This is a really delicious soup, with a very silky mouthfeel.  The only think I'll do different next time is add some broth/liquid - I added extra V8 but it still came out with more like a chili or stew consistency.

My guys loved this soup.  DS thought it was like a goulash and chili soup mixed together.  He loved it.  DH did too.  They thought the leftovers the next day were just as good if not better.  Thank you for sharing with us.
Taste just like Olive Garden, thanks for sharing

Hello everyone! This is just a notation as I haven't yet made this yet. I read many of the reviews and noticed quite a few people stating that their broth was rather thick. One way, someone already mentioned by saying to drain and rinse the beans. The other way is to cook the pasta, drain and rinse it, THEN add it to the soup. It will have already given up it's starch, therefore it won't thicken up your broth.It's cold and rainy here in Las Vegas and this is going to be dinner! Hope this helps! Personally, I like my soup on the tick side, so I probably won't drain and rinse my pasta first, but will instead add a little chicken broth or stock to the soup either while still cooking or whenever I serve leftovers. Hope this helps!
The taste is spot on!  It is much thicker than OG's so I added 4 c chicken broth.  Yum!

I made this yesterday, and my family and I all loved it!  My only changes were to double the V-8 juice and add about a quart of water.  PLUS, I cooked the pasta separately and kept it aside.  I added it to the amount being served for that meal.  I must say next time I will use some other pasta, small seashells or elbows.  The ditalini all stuck together and looked like a beehive.
Highly recommend this. It is a meal in itself. Could of added a little more pasta.  Will definitely make it again. A five star in my book.
I made this today and it is as close to the Olive garden recipe that you can get. Absolutely delicious!

I've made similar recipes before and also have eaten this Italian Soup in restaurants. I made this using Canneloni beans instead of Great Northerns and also added a small can of Green Lima Beans to the mixture. Their texture holds up well and I've had them in this soup before. I used both Ground Beef and Ground Bulk Italian Sausage cooked together and added a couple of extra cloves of garlic. It tastes great but was a little thick. Needs more liquid, maybe another can of V-8 Juice. I also mixed this up and put it in a Crock-Pot before leaving for work and let it cook on low for 8 hours. Made Toasted Garlic Bread to go with it. Topped it with some grated mozzarella and fresh grated Parmesan. It made quite a bit so I let the remainder cool and froze it in small plastic containers, so I can thaw, heat and eat again when I don't feel like cooking.

I couldn't beleive tthis cake tasted as wonderful as it looked! I grated semi-sweet choclate over the topping after it set for an hour, then served to my friends on Valentines Day! They LOVED it! Thanks!
I made this as part of my contribution to a potluck and our friends absolutely loved it!  So delicious.  Thanks!
It was very easy to make. It tasted amazing very good cake. I will make again and again
Wonderful, easy to make, so good my wife is asking me to make another and the first one isn't even gone yet!
Really delicious--so rich and wonderful!  Will make it a lot.  Pretty quick and easy!  Lots of calories and chosterol however.
Luscious!!I made it with Chocolate Fudge Cake Mix instead of the Marble and melted good quality chocolate chips with butter and drizzeled on top. It was so good!
Served this recipe to visiting relatives.  My son-in-law liked it so much he wanted to take some home with him. I will definitely make this recipe again.  Thanks. Jan
Jeannie from Indiana,  Your cake was awesome! Easy to make! That was to die for Steve! Thank you, Jeannie Mussatto. 9/21/2003

Wow!  Thought I'd try this recipe and am I glad I did.  Out of the several recipies I have tried from this Site, this is by far my favorite.  Not only  is this cake delicious, it looks so great!  You don't have to be a master chef for this cake to turn out perfect!

This cake was wonderful!  I made it today for a party at work and everyone requested the recipe.  I was curious how all that ricotta cheese was going to work out, but it turned out beautiful.  The cheese layer sunk to the bottom and formed a delicious creamy layer.  The texture reminds me of tiramisu and it cut into squares perfectly.  I used some reduced fat ingredients and can probably make it even lighter next time.  Thanks for a great recipe!

Even though I'm not a chocolate cake lover (ok, so I'm a little weird), I made this to take to a dinner party.  I'm rating this 5 stars because the hostess absolutely LOVED it!  She liked it because she said that it wasn't too sweet.  The cake was very easy to make.  The only problem I had was that after an hour, when I tested it, the toothpick came out very wet.  My oven thermometer registered at slightly under 350 degrees but I figured that it was okay because I was using a glass baking dish.  I had to keep it in the oven more than 20 extra minutes.  Thank you for the recipe.

This cake was...odd.  Some people who tasted mine liked it and some didn't.  Although the frosting was excellent with the pudding, the ricotta seemed to give the whole cake an odd flavor.  I probably won't make this again.
Presentation is NICE!  Texture is definitely different,rather spongy, which makes me think of "custard."  Not a sweet cake, but very good & everyone liked it.
I served the cake at a dinner party I held, it went over very well. I personally didn't like the flavor of the ricotta, but it does keep the cake tasting moist.

I've been making this cake for many years and always had great results and great reviews. 
Being Italian I'm accustomed to deserts with ricotta fillings. I cant even count the people who have requested this recipe from me.  
To cut down on the cholesterol I used Egg-Beaters instead of the real thing and also used part skim ricotta.

Perfect dessert! I made two of these (one for teacher luncheon and other for dinner party). Surprisingly, one baked in an hour and 10 minutes, and the other in an hour and 25 minutes. I made the cake the day before and frosting the next morning and shaved some Hershey bars on top. This set up perfectly and cut like a dream. I couldn't believe the ricotta (added a bit of almond extract to it with the vanilla) sinks towards the bottom and makes a custard-like layer. This ended my lasagna (Pianolady's Paula Deen) dinner perfectly, just like a tiramisu or a Tres Leche cake. This is going to be my entertaining dessert of choice from now on.

Roxygirl
We like this cake very much. I have made it for several years now.  Very nice chocolate cake to make.  Thanks for posting.
There's a lady where I work that makes this cake and uses the same recipe. REALLY good, and so easy.

I must say I was really amazed at how good this was.  The longer it sits in the refrigerator, the better it gets.  At first I was not that impressed, but a couple of days later I tried it again and WOW!  Thanks for posting.

This is a very good cake - different from a regular cake.  I didn't think the bottom cheese layer had very much flavor so I increased sugar to 1 cup and used almond extract the second time I made it and thought it was much better.  Will make this again as my family loved it.
SUPER delicious and very easy to make.  Thanks for sharing!

So easy and so good.  Very rich indeed, a chocolate lover's dream.
Great cake!!!

We love this cake. My recipe calls for only 3/4 C sugar and sometimes I sprinkle cocoa on it before I serve it. I baked one on Saturday and took the leftovers to work on Monday. I had to make 10 copies of the recipe to give out!

OK, so I have made this now 5 times and I am finally rating it.  This is the best dessert!  So easy to make, easy to serve, and easy to eat!  A little too easy to eat in fact, too easy to eat all of it in one sitting!  Thanks alot for the extra 5 pounds this year!!!

I finally had the chance to bake this cake after seeing the recipe on here a few times! It came out great! I substituted Splenda for the sugar and used fat free Cool Whip just to keep the calories down. The cake only took 45 minutes to bake in my oven. I kept an eye on the cake as I noticed it began to brown before the recommended hour was up,but if I had left it in any longer it would have burned. It came out a beautiful golden brown on top. I grated dark chocolate shavings over the frosting before chilling it in the fridge. It made for a beautiful presentation! Everyone loved it!  Thanks so much for the recipe, Steve!

A coworker once made this for me when I lived in the States, and I absolutely love it.  It's one of the best cakes of its sort that I've tried before.  It's just a shame that it uses a lot of pre-packaged ingredients, simply because I can't find good substitutes here in the UK.  Some day, I will find a way to make it here. :-)
My Italian family has had this recipe in it's collection for years. We LOVE this cake and it often makes a showing at family gatherings! Enjoy!

I have made this twice now. I was going to give it a rating, and see now that I'd forgotten to rate it for the first one I'd made. So now, can I give it a rating of 10? Seriously, this is "the" cake! I gave some to my neighbors, and they loved it. My hubby loved it, and he's hard to please. Thanks for this unbelievably awesome cake.
To be perfectly honest, it didn't have any flavor. The recipe sounded great, but mine went to waste

It tastes like a 9x13 pan of chocolate eclairs =) YUMMY and I am not a 'Betty Crocker' but made this for dessert to go along with a spaghetti and meatball dinner with friends and I was amazed that I could bake something...LOL Thx 4 sharing.
This dessert was a star to my dinner...Wow, I used sugar free pudding and cool whip and low fat ricotta, but you would have never known it....fabulous...

I couldn't get my cousin to stop going in our refrigerator and eating it!!! Just for that reason I might make this just for him as a Christmas gift!!!!! I used a devil food's cake instead of marble...yummy!!! I might try a brownie mix next time-definitely curious how that will turn out!!!
was great!!!!! made this for a function and everybody loved it. i even made more icing. was hoping there would be some left for me to eat, there was, just a small crumb. thanks for the recipe
Made this for Mother's Day. It was great!!!
Took it to work for a potluck to share with my coworkers. Weeks later they are still talking about it! Easy to put together!

This went over reallllyyyy well with my guests. Shortly after I rate this, I will be forwarding the recipe on to various friends that asked for it. The only change was I used a dark chocolate cake instead of the marble, as it was what I had on hand, and also i subbed part of the milk with a 1/4 cup of chambourd because I thought that would add a nice taste to the topping. I also shaved semi-sweet chocolate over the top.
I did not get as far as putting on the topping.... kinda sad with the way the cake turned out kinda mushy at the bottom.... i guess this is for some but not for our house.. thanx though

I thought this cake was fantastic and anything BUT bland!  Delicate, yes...not overpowering.  I thought the texture was fantastic and a great flavor combination.  I made the cake part exactly according to the recipe.  The only change I made was the topping in which I used real whipped cream only b/c I don't like cool whip!  I will totally make this again.
Our family has made this for years, it's wonderful.  It is just as good with lemon cake mix and lemon pudding in place of the chocolate!  Try it!

This cake turned out great! This was not a "sweetcake" but still tasty, and easy to make. It took the full hour to bake, I almost wanted to take it out sooner because the top was getting so brown, but the center was jiggly, so I left in the whole hour and turned out perfect.

DO NOT make cupcakes with these. The filling will sink to the bottom a crumble everywhere. They did taste very good though, with the help of a plate and fork. Next time I'll try it with lemon cake and vanilla topping.
This is an easy 5 star recipe. I made it exactly as written and it came out fantastic. Everyone loved it and I am sure to get requests to make this often. Thanks for sharing a great recipe!!
This was good, but better the next day.  If you love ricotta, you'll love this cake!

The first time I made this it was awesome!!! The second time it has a bit of a 'wang' to it,I put it in a glass pan the first time and a metal pan the second and i believe the ricotta reacted with the metal and that was what the problem was, so only make this in a glass pan. Just a suggestions to be on the safe side. Really awesome cake, not to sweet, gonna make if for an Italian dinner party with the in-laws!! Wish me luck!!!
I made this last night. I use glass pan and it came out so good. This a KEEPER!! Thanks for posting

I gave this recipe 3 stars because both times I made it, it wasn't done after an hour. I had to put it back in  to finish cooking. I even took it out to see if it would "set" while cooling. It clearly wasn't done. I don't know what, if anything, I'm doing wrong. The second time I made it I even used less of the cheese mixture. Any suggestions/help would be appreciated. I love this cake, but can't quite master it. Thanks!
I have made this twice.  Both times it was a favorite for my family and co-workers.  I cannot give it 5 stars.  It is a good "go to" cake in a hurry.

I think I found myself a winner!  This cake is so good I couldn't leave the pan alone.  I used a Wilton cake pan, non-stick, and had no problems with any metal taste while eating it.   I made it using regular  chocolate pudding and mixed with Cool Whip it was a great topping for this yummy cake!

I have made this cake twice. It takes 80-90 min to bake, not the 1 hr as stated in recipe. It does not dry out due to longer baking time. Your knife must come out clean for this cake to be done. The longer time I stated is correct as I have baked this in two different ovens and baking time was the same.One was in my gas oven at home, the other was a electric oven while on vacation in my time share condo. Don't be afraid to bake this, oh sooooooo delicious cake! Enjoy

I thought this was really tasty!  :)  I made it exactly as stated, and it is oh so moist with every bite!  It is also very rich in taste, so I think you could get away with even cutting this into 24 pieces (I cut it into even more than that) and still have it be the perfect ending to a meal.  I will be making this a few times a year, I am sure.  Thank you for such a wonderfully easy recipe to make, and yummy to boot!
Made this cake. It was good if you like alot of ricotta cheese.  Guess i was expecting something better.  More of a cheese cake fan.

Baked this cake 1 1/2 hours and it was barely done. I found the flavor of this cake just ok. The topping on the other hand was rather tasty, almost mousse like. The good thing about this cake is that it is not very sweet.

Made this for a dinner party and was a total hit! I am not a baker, more of a cook, but this was easy and delicious. The only issue was the pudding and cool whip topping, it got a little runny, still yummy though...any suggestions on how to keep or get the topping fluffier would be appreciated.

I didn't have any ricotta, so I substituted 2 oz. blocks of cream cheese and used 3 eggs and 1/2 cup sugar. Baked for 50 minutes and came out perfectly. Also, I don't like the chemical taste of 'whipped topping' so I beat a cup of whipping cream with a tbsp of sugar and folded that into the pudding mix/milk mixture. This cake is so much better after spending the night in the fridge. Delicious! Initially, my husband was put off a bit by the texture - whipped cream, cheesecake, and flour cake. But he came around pretty quickly. Nice cake to add into the rotation.
Light, similar to tiramisu, but actually better.  This was a huge hit with family and friends.  Thanks!

I unfortunately was disapointed with this recipe. The cake was a little dry and the ricotta mixture really didn't add anything to the cake. I had high hopes for this cake and this missed the mark at our house.

Have been making this for years. One of my favorites....everyone LOVES it!  

So easy to make and looks & tastes GREAT

Needed an quick and easy dessert for an Italian themed dinner party we were invited to and this was certainly quick and easy. Looked very impressive too, everyone enjoyed it. Topped mine with chopped toasted almonds for just a little extra. Thanks for posting

Very easy and delicious, not too sweet. My cake rose so high that I couldn't spread the topping over it in the pan. Rather, I spread the topping over each cut piece and sprinkled with some shaved milk chocolate. I will be making this again for sure.
I love Alfredo sauce over pasta but have never before seen a recipe for it. This recipe sounds really good.
I have to say, this was SO EASY to make.  I used Romanco instead of parmesan (error on my part at the store when buying stuff).  It was still good though!  Thanks Tish!  Husband LOVED  it!

I have been using this recipe for years and love it. I do substitute non-fat cottage cheese for the ricotta and I partially cook the noodles. Often I use so many vegetables that I end up using a 9x13" pan so it doesn't overflow. This recipe always gets rave reviews from guests.
Easy and Tasty.  I have never made Lasagna and this turned out great! I added so many veggies I also used a larger dish. :)

I LOVE THIS! I busted out my mandolin and sliced 1 zucchini, 1 red bell pepper and 1 sweet onion. I gave them a quick saute with nonstick olive oil Pam and some italian seasoning. I used part skim mozzarella and halved the amount, and used lowfat cottage cheese and halved the amount(personal preference). This was amazingly good, and so hard to believe it is only 6 points!  Thanks for the great recipe!
Unbelievably easy and good!  Thanks so much!

This was really good for a low fat, meatless meal.  I used 2 zucchinis and 12 oz. of baby portebella mushrooms with ragu's 7 herb spaghetti sauce in a 9x13 pan.  My dh thought it was ok, but both my toddler and I thougt it was really yummy.  I still can't believe it is only 6 points.

My 13-yo son has been begging me to make this recipe since he found it here on Zaar for a couple of weeks and I'm sure glad that I did! As far as lasagna's go, this one was very easy to put together and tasted great. I used mushrooms, green pepper, onion and a small tomato for my veggies.  Since I couldn't find fat free ricotta, I used half light ricotta and half fat-free cottage cheese and decreased the amount of shredded cheese to cut a few calories. I should have taken Krittlin's advice and put it in a 13x9 dish because my 11x7 was full to the brim and bubbled up and over the edge - yikes! We had lots of leftovers and we all enjoyed. Will make again - thanks for sharing Divinemom!
This is sooo good!!! Used bell peppers and mushrooms and low low-fat cottage cheese instead of ricotta.  Did use about 8 lasagna and added much more veggies (about 3 cups!).  Thanks Divinemom!
Easy, healthy, and tasty.  I've been trying to find good non-meat meals to try and this one worked with wife and kids.

Fabulous! I have just one question to fellow Easy Cheese Lasagna makers:
How long should I cook  it  before freezing a lasagna to use at a later time? And how long would I have to cook it  to warm it ?
amazing! i can't have enough of it. i need more recipes like this one.
I like to add a layer of fresh baby spinach to all my lasagna recipes.

Simple, easy, GREAT!!!! 
Thanks!

This is amazing. We have it all the time when we lounge in cafes in Europe on holiday and sometimes for a special treat at home. Remember to use very cold, hard ice cream so it doesn't melt all at once when you pour the espresso over.

This is too delicious.  Lucky for me, my BF doesn't like coffee so this made one lovely large serving all for me!  Yum!  I used Double Rainbow French Vanilla ice cream- its really good and apparently "the official ice cream of San Francisco" (don't know why that matters)  Anyhow, this is just a dream- warm, spicy-bitter espresso with creamy smooth vanilla ice cream.  I love coffee ice cream, but again, because BF doesn't like coffee I never get it.  I would say this is a nice compromise, but its not really- its even better!  Be sure your espresso is quite hot- I let mine cool a bit while I prepared the ice cream and the ice cream cooled it too quickly.  Lovely lovely recipe.  Will make again at every possible opportunity.  :)
DH made this with more coffee and low fat coffee ice cream, and it was just delicious! Make sure the coffee is not too hot, so the ice cream doesn't completely melt.

We always add olive oil to this and let it set on the table to put on bread.   But my Italian family loves this so much we put it on our steaks or baked chicken, really on anything you want, great on salmon at the table.  We only use flat leaf parsley, we find it has the best flavor.
I have been making this for quite a while.  I usually use less garlic but my garlic is pretty strong.  Great toping for savory stews and soups!
What a wonderful burst of bright flavours! I used this to top pasta; added a splash of olive oil and a sprinkling of sea salt and munched happily away.

Whoa!!!  Wish I could give this way more than 5 stars!!  My DH kept coming into the kitchen happily sniffing the air, and then after dinner sat back and said, "That soup was AWESOME!!!"  :)  This was incredibly easy and so fast!  I made as directed, although I think I probably didn't quite put 10 ounces of spinach in.  The fresh basil is wonderful!  Thank you so much, Mirj!!  This will definitely make our list of top favorite soups!

My family and I really enjoyed this soup--even my two picky kids ate it!  I actually used 2 cans of tomatoes and it was perfect for us.  I am having the last bowl today for lunch and the leftovers are even better!!! Served with salad and garlic bread. Thanks for posting!
Excellent!  Hubby loved it.  Easy to make, and a great way to use up extra spinach. I used dried tortellini as it's less expensive and more convenient.

I'm making this a second time because it was so good the first! GREAT flavor! We couldn't stop eating it! This time I'm going to add some shredded chicken to the recipe to give it a little twist. THANKS for sharing!

This is a fantastic recipe. A clean tasting, warm you up from the inside, excellent on a cold day soup. I used frozen spinach in this, because I had it on hand, but I imagine that the fresh spinach is a bit nicer. Thanks for sharing!

This is our new favourite soup.  It is so tasty and quick to make. We used 6 c. of veggie broth instead of 4 c. and 2 c. of water, as well as a little extra tortellini.  We can't wait to share this with company!

Looking for a differnet tomato soup? You just found it. This recipe is fast, fresh, and delicious.  Best of all, it's not fussy; you can add or reuce almost any ingredient and still enjoy a hearty a nd mutitious soup. I doubled the tomaotes, used dried pasta and frozen spinach.  Yum!!
We love this recipe! Use all the garlic...it totally makes the soup. Maybe I'm crazy, but when I'm coming down with a cold, I eat this soup, and I swear the cold is gone the next morning.

Sooooo tasty and delicious, and it was enough for two meals. I used frozen spinach, homemade veggie broth, and dried basil. Served with warm crusty bread (perfect to sop up the soup with!) and salad. Thanks for such a great recipe, perfect for something different on a cold winter's night!!!
Absolutely wonderful.  DH asks for it all the time in the winter.  I double the recipe, except for the amount of spinach, and we get two dinners and lunch out of it.  Delicious!

This was a quick and extremely tasty soup to prepare and eat! The only changes I made were, substituting olive oil for the butter; substituting Dreamfields penne pasta for the tortellini; adding some red pepper to give it a little more zest and instead of the fresh basil, which I did not have on hand, I added a teaspoon of prepared pesto. Great soup!
This was good.  The only change I made was to add shredded chicken breast I had seasoned with garlic and lemon pepper to make this more of a main course. Thanks, Mirj.
Wow, I wish I knew what I did wrong. Apparently it was something! This came out as an oddball clutch of ingredients that didn't quite come together. My apologies for being negative.
Sounds delicious!

I used ground bison instead of beef and added some onions, topped it with bread crumbs, and a little salt to it.  I skipped the spinach of course!  It was awesome!  You can use any kind of cheese, I only had Cheddar on hand, so that worked just fine too.

FABULOUS! I used lean ground turkey instead of beef but other than that I followed the recipe as it. It was great! I think next time I will add onions and bell peppers. But this was very good! Thanks for posting!

Delicate yet flavoursome, and elegant enough for a dinner party!  The only change I made was to use slightly more lemon & zest, considerably more Tabasco & a sprinkling of freshly cracked pepper.  I added the zucchini to the shrimp towards the end of the cooking time, which worked out well. Thank you for a delicious recipe I will make again.

This was delicious! I used Campanelle pasta shells in place of the spaghetti. Worked out nicely. I kinda guess on how much butter (2Tbs) to use since it didn't say in the ingredients and I also added alittle more olive oil. Thanks for sharing the recipe!
A vegetarian alternative would be to use crumbled dried bean curd sticks. They even look like chicken!

It really only takes about 15 minutes to make this great dressing.  I make it all the time in a mason jar or old large jelly jar with a good lid.  Old Chinese take-out soup containers are goo too.  Add all the indredients, make sure to whip up the egg before you add it, and shake for a bit.  It will turn a creamy color.  Chill about an hour and toss it with salad.  My entire family loves it!  And even my husband is impressed that I can just whip up a salad dressing.

This has got to be the greatest copy cat recipe ever! I have made this for several years, now, and is a huge hit every time I make it. I will make a huge bowl of salad and take it to work-an office of about 20 women and 12 men-they will argue over who took too much and who gets the last serving! I make it in my large processor and I find the consistancy is wonderful. I like it a little thicker, so I add a little more pectin. Thanks for an awesome recipe!!!

We thought this was a first-rate italian salad dressing.  Whether it's a clone of Olive Garden or not, I couldn't say.  Have never been to Olive Garden.  Doesn't matter to us.  It's a dandy dressing and we really enjoyed it.  It's super-easy to mix up, chill, and serve.  I'll definitely be using it in the future.
Laudee C.
This is an excellent salad dressing, very similar, if not identical to Olive Garden's Salad Dressing. We enjoyed it very much! Thank you, Tonkcats for submitting this recipe!

I served this over baby spinach, sundried tomatoes, white mushrooms and pine nuts - made an excellent salad. My guests couldn't agree whether it does or doesn't taste like the Olive Garden salad dressing, but everyone agreed that it's a great Italian dressing. I'll make this often. Thanks!
This is a great Italian dressing! A little creamier than the Olive Garden's but my hubby and our guests thought it was GREAT!! Thanks for an excellent recipe that will be made often!
Doesn't quite LOOK like Olive Garden's dressing, but the blend of flavors is exquisite!  Great job.

I didn't say anything to my DH and he said about 5 times that it tasted like Olive Garden!  I used pre-made garden salad and poured the dressing over and let it sit for a few minutes.  I garnished with whole black olives and roma tomatoes.  I used olive oil and ommited the egg.  I didn't have any pectin which would have thickend it up.  I thought the vinegar was a little strong, I  might cut back on that next time.  We haven't eaten this much salad since the last trip to the Olive Garden.

Well - it WASN'T Olive Garden - but it is FABULOUS! THIS is a keeper! I mixed up a bunch of greens, added freshly-grated Romano & freshly-grated Parmesan cheese, and a can of big black olives (whole) - tossed w/ the greens just before serving - and WOW! Took the salad to Thanksgiving dinner (added olives, cheeses & dressing once there), and got 4 requests for the recipe! 

Thank you SO much for sharing! A hit - and will be made time & time again!

Maybe not quite the Olive Garden, but so good that you don't care.  I was craving this dressing, but not a visit to the restraunt.  Even my hubby (who always orders soup, not salad) likes the crispness of this dressing.  Now, all I need are some great breadsticks to go with my salad...lol :)
This dressing is easy to perpare and delicious. My family really enjoyed it. Thanks!!
Great dressing!  Close in taste to Olive Garden-same general idea anyway...I'll be making it again!

I found this far too sweet and didn't think it tasted anything like the olive gardens dressing.  My husband didn't mind the flavour, but we definately did not think it tasted anything like olive gardens.  Sorry-I really wanted it to taste like Olive Gardens.
Most excellent and will make it again.
good
I halved the entire recipe to serve two people.  It turned out wonderful.  I didn't have any pectin, but it still turned out great.  Thanks for a great recipe.
Great dressing!  I love Olive Garden's salad and this was pretty close.  I made it for company and it received lots of complitments.  Thanks for posting!
Had this recipe and lost it.  I was crushed. I am so glad I have found it again! Delicious!!
Delicious dressing.  Even worked w/out pectin and with sugar instead of corn syrup.  (Was very watery, but still tasty).

I have made this dressing for several years and LOVE it! It has a unique tangy flavor and with the pectin makes for a creamy texture. I have made it without the pectin in a pinch, but it is far better with it. I also have made it with white sugar and honey,  but the corn syrup is much better (I was surprised how much!). I do add more oregano and red pepper flakes, and a little extra cheese doesn't hurt. I've also made it with red wine vinegar, but didn't like it as much. Usually, I'm all for making substitutions in a pinch, but following the directions closely really results in a better dressing. I've also used this on a variety of lettuces, but prefer romaine the most. This would taste great on a chopped salad, too. I'm going to make it tomorrow for some dinner guests. I know they will love it.

Roxygirl in Colo.
After so many great reviews, I knew this would be a perfect dressing to use for recipe#101490. It added a pefect flavour to the salad and was enjoyed by all!
This is the best salad dressing I ever made following a recipe.  I highly recomended.  It easy!

This was excellent! I was out of dried parsley flakes and used fresh instead.. my dressing has a green cast to it, like green goddess dressing. The flavor was great.. it tastes a little strong when I tasted it from a spoon, but once it coats the salad veggies.. Perfect!  Better than any bottled dressings I have tried, and would be great on pasta salad. I will be making this recipe again for sure! Thanks for posting!

A very very close copycat of this delicious dressing.  I have been using this recipe for years now, but with just a slight difference in technique of putting it together.  I add the vinegar, lemon juice, egg and blend that in my mini processor for 10 seconds. I let that rest for 10 minutes before adding the remaining ingredients and blending for 30 seconds on low.  I chill for at least 1 hr before using to make sure all the flavors are blended.  It is a little thin if you don't use the eggs or pectin, but still so yummy.  Some people say when you add the eggs with the vinegar and lemon juice, it will kill any Salmonella that may be present.  Or you could just use a pasteurized egg product.  I think this is a closer recipe than others that contain mayonnaise...  Thanks for sharing!

Okay, so I went into making this recipe with a very pessimistic view. I've heard non-stop negative reviews for attempts to make the Olive Garden dressing. First, I purchased the original bottle at Olive Garden. Wayyy too expensive, there's hardly any dressing, and you're paying for a heavy glass bottle! I was running low, so I wanted to try a few recipes. Thank god I tried this one first... I followed it to par, using light corn syrup and everything else as listed. I let it chill for 3 hours while I ran errands, came back, and sampled each dressing on a plate. Yes, it was very tart, and I'd have to agree, it wasn't quite Olive Garden's dressing. It needed more garlic powder in addition to the fresh garlic. I added probably about 1 1/2 tsp of garlic powder and voila! PERFECT, if not BETTER... The bottled one tastes more bland, and that's probably because of preservatives. This recipe is brighter in taste than the bottled Olive Garden one. Definitely my favorite now...And seriously, side by side, they look almost identical. This recipe turned out a little more yellow than the bottled Olive Garden one, and a little more rustic and chunky than the bottled one, but over all wayyyy better than Olive Garden's own!!! Totally a keeper. Just add more garlic powder at the end. :) Yay! THANK YOU SO MUCH for posting it!!!!!! <3

A great one for mushroom-lovers.  I made this just as written and it was great.  It's a lovely side dish, but I could even eat this over pasta as a main dish.  Thanx for sharing!

Dancer - your were a standing ovation at my dinner party. The saltimboccas was wonderful. Excellent dish! Made it for my Sicilian FIL along with recipe#110910(Italian Bread and Tomato Soup)and my own recipe for mozzerella stuffed baked tomatoes and the whole dinner was a hit!Not a morsel left on anyone's plate, including mine.

Most excellent white sauce I have ever made!  I substituted sun-dried tomatos for the plum and added artichoke hearts! Yummy!!
This is really really good.  I used a 28 oz can of crushed tomatoes which worked OK--added a bit more of the other stuff and more crushed red pepper.  Yummy.  We've had this several times already.

OMG!  This is SO good and easy.  I made this with Rotini as that is what I had on hand.  Used Skyy vodka and served with Italian sausage and onions on the side with a salad.  Perfect.  Thank you U. Bill

Yes sir Uncle Bill does it again!  I used Rotella crushed tomatoes with chilies instead of the plum and some really crappy Vodka one of my cheap friends left.  Turned out super.  Thanks for a home for cheap Vodka!

Wonderful.  We used the sauce over ravioli and will definitely make again - I can't wait to try over gnocchi.  The only change I made was to use a 14.5oz can of tomatoes. a little spicy and could use more salt but easy and quite delicious!
Simply fantastic and DH loved it. I didn't have whipping cream so I added mascarpone. Thank you Uncle Bill.

We (my Husband and I) really enjoyed this!  I made it a tad different.  I used tri-color rotini pasta and a can of ready-cut diced tomatoes. I also used a 28 oz can of tomatoes, and increased the amounts of other ingredients.
Absolutely fantastic!
I ate it over spaghetti squash, while the rest of the family had the linguine.

FANTASTIC! Easy to make and easier to eat! Thanks for posting! This definitely goes in the keeper file. :)

Very good- hubbie loved it and would have given it 5 stars, I think it needs a little something. But then, there is a local restaurant that serves a pasta with Vodka Sauce that is soooo good (but I'm sure mucccchhh more fattening then this one- it is so much thicker and smoother (aka creamier)) so maybe I need to stop comparing it the theirs....
One word of advise- I "broke" the sauce! I didn't temper the cream (I used 1/2 and 1/2) (I think that is what it is called- when you add hot to cold so it won't separate??)- well mine separated. If you don't want this to happen, you temper it by adding some of the warm sauce, a spoonful at a time- 4-5 spoonfulls, to the cream to warm it before you add it in. I was too lazy- and since no one else commented that it happened to them, I figured I would go for it- and I paid for it!! :0) It's not a big deal- it just makes it look funky. I will make this one again- but I want to figure out how to make it a bit thicker.
Fabulous recipe!   I sauteed shrimp in olive oil and garlic and added to the sauce.   Restaurant quality.

Very good! The rustic style beans were just perfect with the lamb. I loved the combination of fresh rosemary and balsamic vinegar. Our guests brought homemade Tuscan bread and we sipped on a Super Tuscan red. The only thing I would do different would be to season the lamb chops with a bit of garlic while cooking them. Our guests left happily with a copy of your recipe.

Outstanding!   Also delicious!

I'm under strict orders to add this to the REGULAR family repertoire.  So, THANKS Derf...this is a KEEPER!

Inez, this was really good, I never thought of making a caesar dressing with mayo so I was surprised (pleasantly) at the taste. I didn't have fresh parmesean so I had to use the Kraft (shaker) instead.
Thanks for posting this! It wazs great with the lasagna I served :)
This was a great salad which we had as a light dinner.  I did mix Parmesan, Romano, and Asiago cheeses.  It was delicious!  Thanks Inez

I wasn't totally sold on the dressing, but I loved the combination of ingredients otherwise. I am always looking for something to add some sizzle to the salad bowl.  Pepperoni did just that without loading the salad with calories.  Thank you for sharing the recipe!
I didn't have any pepper or Parmesan, but added a slice of white cheddar cheese on top.  A nice alternative to the regular spread.  Looks nice, too.

WOW, totally awesome!!  Not only fast to make but so delicious!  Only problem is there wasn't enough for seconds.  I will definitely keep this recipe and double it.  Oh it is so good!  Thanks Iron Bloomers

So fast, easy and terrific! DH wants it on the keeper list and thats fine with me! I didn't have any fresh basil on hand so I used about 1/2 to 1 tsp Dried Italian Seasoning and 1 tbls water at the end of sauteing. Thanks so much for sharing this recipe!

Very, very good, these taste even better than my Italian mother in law's! Otherwise this recepie is very easy.
Tasty. I liked them, the kids liked them.

I love rice balls from Italian restaurants so when I saw this recipe, I absolutely had to try it out.  I have to say, I don't know how anyone gets these to stay together.  I found it near impossible, they fell apart by the time I would get to the bread crumbs.  I  had to add like 3 more eggs to the mixture to even get them to remotely stay in a ball shape.  Even then, I had a very hard time dipping them in 3 different things.  I got frustrated and just ended up mixing the breadcrumbs into the mixture and just made them into balls that way. I served the chops with egg noodles and roasted carrot and asparagus spears. A hit - Thanks Tom!

This easy and very good dish will be served at my house a lot! This is good!!

I made this for DH's birthday dinner and it was a huge hit. this dish was delicious. Thanks for posting it.
Wonderful recipe, and so easy! I halved the recipe and pureed the sauce for a smoother texture .. thanks!

If I could give 100 stars I would!  Fettucine Alfredo is my all time FAVORITE meal and this was SO PERFECT!  The chicken was SO juicy and the sauce was absolutely incredible.  This is the ONLY alfredo I'll be making for a LONG time.  THANKS!

Delicious! Not too hard to make and it tasted like it was right out of an Italian restaraunt. Personally, I add a little extra cheese, but other than that... fantastic!
Was a bit bland, needed something else.  Wouldn't make again
Easy and tasty.  I had to substitute marble cheese and whole milk for the cream.  (I added a bit of flour to the whole milk to thicken it up a bit.)  BF loved it and I enjoyed it too.

I think this pasta is just bland.  I added more salt and cayenne, but it still lacks taste... Remember to use a nonstick skillet to cook the floured chicken or else it'll stick in your pan very badly.

I really loved this pasta!  I used bow ties instead of fettuccine and it turned out wonderful.  I hope I'm not the only one when I say this...but what in the world is LIGHT CREAM?  (lol)  I looked it up online and I guess its a table cream with 18%-30% fat (for those that don't know).  I figured fat free half and half would work, but last minute I switched it up to whole milk.  AND WHAT A GOOD CALL!  For those of you using whole milk, don't forget to add 1-2 tablespoon of flour if the sauce isn't thick enough.  Also, if you really, really want the chicken to come out YUMMY, I would recommend using LAND O LAKES LOW FAT BUTTER.  I think my favorite part was the chicken :)  All in all, for those of you that want a quick and tasty, homemade alfredo recipe, TRY THIS ONE!

MizzNezz, you've done it again!  As my 16 yo daughter says: "You can't go wrong with a MizzNezz recipe."  I made this with Perdue pre-seasoned Italian style fresh chicken breasts, so I didn't use salt and pepper on the chicken.  They worked wonderfully in this dish.  The chicken already had some sort of Italian seasoning all over it, plus salt and pepper, so when I make this recipe again, I will use the same type of chicken or add some Italian seasoning to the flour.  A couple of changes I made out of necessity: I used linguine instead of fettuccine, I used skim milk instead of cream (I added two tbl. of flour to the butter, onion, garlic mixture) and I used a freshly grated 3 cheese Italian blend of Parmesan, Asiago and Romano instead of just Parmesan.  The ONLY thing I think this recipe needs is the addition of salt to the sauce and that is a personal preference.  Because some cheese is salty (especially the canned kind) and there is salt in the butter, it may be enough for some people, so taste before serving ;).  Thanks so much for posting this...this is definitely going into our bi-weekly dinner cookbook!
I am ashamed to say that I skipped instructions 1-9 and added a can of chicken in the end.  It was so awesome even when I cheated.  Thank you!
So yummy and so easy! I've made this several times and it has become one of my favorites!

Great recipe. Everybody loved it. Thanks for sharing.

This was good!  I cut up the chicken breasts into strips, but followed the recipe otherwise...will probably reserve this one for special occasions with the amount of cream and butter that is in it!  It sure makes it yummy, though.  One note, I used a stainless frying pan to cook my chicken and it left quite a bit of browned bits stuck to the bottom.  When I poured the cream in, it came up eventually to flavor the sauce even more...

WONDERFUL! So delicious!  My husband LOVED the chicken and really liked the Alfredo sauce.
I used linguine pasta and added a little bit of cream cheese into the sauce.
FANTASTIC! Thank you!

Absolutely delicious and easy to make.  Perfect for a weeknight family meal, or for a dinner party. My only changes to the recipe were to use thin spaghetti, which I prefer over fettuccini...it worked beautifully in the dish. I also used the entire 16 oz. box, and had plenty of sauce to coat the pasta.  I omitted the parsley, b/c I didn't have any, and doubled the amount of Parmesan cheese to 1 cup.  The red pepper flakes add that little kick that no one could quite place, but made the dish stand out.  This one is a keeper!
My man is a die hard alfredo fan and he loved this!

This was good. We like alot of sauce and this wasn't enough so next time I will adjust that part of the recipe. Also, I may try onion powder and garlic powder instead of minced to see which I like better. We will enjoy this again!

Really very good!  The seasoning on the chicken was perfect and the sauce came together very quickly, and tasted great!  Served as a type of Italian Noodle Bowl with chicken and broccoli on top of egg noodles with sauce poured over the top.  Everyone loved it, even my husband who claims not to be a fan of Alfredo.

Easy and tasty. I was attempting to feed 3 kids with a taste for the frozen ready-meal version, so I cubed the chicken, and then put it back into the sauce with the fettucine.  It was so good that no-one complained about the frozen broccoli I threw in near the end.

This dish receives the ultimate accolade - the eldest child will re-schedule her social life to eat it.
My step daughter is an alfredo "anything" fanatic.  This dinner was enjoyed by the whole family.  Definitely a must make again recipe
Was looking for a fast fettuccine alfredo recipe, made this with shrimp instead of chicken, left out the flour and parsley, came out fantastic.  It was devoured :) Thanks!
I made this tonight and it was AWESOME!  DH and DD loved it too (and DD is pretty pickey!)  Thanks so much for the recipe!
Made it last week and it was very good and easy to make.Thanks for the recipe!!

I made this into a vegetarian version by using the Quorn "chicken" breasts.  We cooked these in the oven for about 20 minutes, then sliced them up and put them on top of the pasta.  (So no need to flour and fry!)  Then we followed the sauce recipe and poured this on top.  We added an extra 1/2 cup of parmesan cheese to the tops of the pasta and stirred this in.  Really tasty!  We'll make this again for sure.

Let me preface this by saying, neither my husband nor I disliked this.  However, I found the sauce a tad bland except for its overabundance of garlic.  I really like garlic, but I thought that 2 tablespoons of minced garlic (I used fresh) was a bit much.  My husband didn't think it was too much.

The chicken was quite flavorful.  I used chicken tenders  so they were quite a bit smaller than full split breasts.  Just a tip for those who aren't used to cooking in pans that aren't non-stick, if you choose to use a pan that's not non-stick, once you put the chicken in DON'T MOVE IT.  Just let it cook and start to turn brown before you attempt to move the chicken around.  It will end up coming up by itself without sticking like crazy.

Overall, this was a nice meal, but not something that I would opt for often.  I hadn't realized how addicted I'd gotten to spicy foods.

I made this for our Valentines Day dinner.  I made as directed, except instead of the chicken I used shrimp.  This is a good sauce it just needed some salt and pepper.  I will make again using the chicken next time.  Thank you for posting.

This was good. I added real red pepper to it rather then flakes.
I also used milk rather than cream. I put in 2 tblsp of flour to the butter, garlic, onions after they were done cooking. That helped to thicken it since I used 1% milk. Anytime I hear "this is good mom" it makes it all worth while : )

Very good..my son had seconds.  I used a splash of chicken stock to deglaze the pan and then added the butter, onions, and garlic.  All I had was heavy cream so I used 1 C. of that and 1/2 C. of 1% milk and 1/3 C. of parmesan.  Next time I might try it with all milk and thicken with flour to reduce the calories. 

 Thanks for the recipe!

I felt like the pepper really overpowered this dish.  I'd like to try it again with the red pepper omitted completely and perhaps with the addition of a bit of ginger.  I prepared this for 3 people, and all pretty much agreed the flavor was very distracted by the dominant heat from the pepper.

I made just the sauce for this recipe as my chicken smelled a little off so I was afraid to use it.  I made the recipe exactly as written except I did follow another reviewer's advice and added a bit of ginger and I used 1/3 cup of parmesan cheese.  It was very good and I'll definitely be making it again.  As good, if not better, than our local Italian restaurant!  Thanks for posting!
I make a couple of changes to this.  I use nutmeg instead of ginger.  So much better!!!  And, I normally use shrimp and also use fat free half/half to cut calories..

I just finished making this.  This is the creamiest, most flavorful alfredo I have ever had.  I did substitute melted butter and milk for the cream b/c I only had a little bit on hand.  To thicken the sauce I added a little cornstarch.  I will defenitely be making this dish again. Thank you very much.

I also chunked my chicken, browned it, and added it to the sauce, but we loved this recipe. Simple, fast, and nice flavor. My husband is very picky and often calls food bland. He had no complaints and even went back for seconds.
This satisfied my craving for comfort food!  I Used shrimp and added mushrooms.  Thanks for a great recipe.

So yummy and so easy! I used a dry chicken rub instead of salt & pepper which gave a ton of extra flavor. Also, I chopped the chicken before adding it back to the sauce. My picky boyfriend loved it! Thanks for sharing!

Rich and delicious, we very much enjoyed this. I also cubed the chicken as we are not great meat eaters, in this was a little goes a lot further.   Quickly made, very nice for evenings when you want to spoil yourself a little.   Thank you MizzNezz!

I made this tonight and it was very good. I didn't see light cream in the store so I used 1 cup of heavy cream and 1/2 cup of 1% milk. Also, instead of seasoning my chicken with salt & pepper, I used garlic salt, garlic powder, onion powder and black pepper. Then, when it was time to add the minced onion and garlic I used a little less than called for. It was so good. I'm going to have to play around with the sauce because it didn't make nearly enough for us. I loved the addition of the red pepper flakes and my 1yr old and 2yr old cleaned their plates!
Really quick easy and yummy!
Terrific! Substituted half & half for the cream and it turned out no less creamy. Easy to make and very delicious!
a HUGE hit! thank you!

Let me start off by saying that I've never really liked alfredo sauce. Now let me tell you:  I LOVE THIS SAUCE!  This is the alfredo sauce that changed my mind.  I did add a bit more garlic b/c I love garlic.  Also I had to use heavy cream b/c I could not find light cream.  Still delicious and I crave this sauce now.  Thanks!!!

I was just a little disappointed with this. Maybe I was expecting it to taste a  bit like Olive Garden's version:) It was tasty, but I probably should have added a little more cream. It was a tad thick. I cut the chicken up before cooking it, which helped it to cook a lot faster. I also cooked the onion & garlic in olive oil instead of butter. Yummy, but not outstanding
Wonderful! I add spinach to the sauce to make it a complete meal. It was a hit!

This was a super easy sauce to make. I cut up some chicken tenders and baked them in Italian seasonings and garlic powder to give the chicken more of a taste. I also used more cream and cheese in the sauce. Added broccoli also. This sauce is the best Alfredo sauce i have ever had, and it taste better than any that I have ever bought.

This was fantastic!  I am not a big chicken fan but thought this had delicious flavor and very simple to make!  I used chicken breast tenders and after I browned them in the skillet I put them in the oven to finish baking.  I thought the sauce would be to thin because I used part regular milk too but it coated the noodles and chicken very well.
One of the easiest and tastiest Alfredo recipes I ever made. I added a little more Parmesan cheese. Thanks for posting it!
Good and quick to fix. Not a traditional Alfredo, but a nice creamy garlic sauce. Next time I'll increase the pasta and sauce since everyone wanted more. Thanks for sharing the recipe!
Quick and easy, and it turned out delicious! Was fine with dried parsley.
I love this recipe. Easy to make and my family loves it. I make it once a week. LOVE LOVE LOVE!!
Delicious. I added lots of sliced mushrooms with the mince because I love them. I will make this again many times.
This is a great recipe!  Simple to make and delicious. Thanks Caryn!
This was another great dish.  Made plenty, ate the leftovers the next day, it tasted even better if that is possible.
This was very good..my family loved it..definitely filled a 9 x 13 pan..thanks for sharing this recipe.

You know, I had never had baked ziti before - even eating out. I found this recipe when I was "on the prowl" for something totally different a couple of nights ago. Followed the recipe to a tee (except I subbed salt-free homemade meatless sauce and low-sodium chicken broth so that I could enjoy it without feeling guilty!) and BINGO! I was in business. Served it with a very crisp green salad topped with very spicy Greek olive oil dressing and my homemade sourdough croutons, and it was a meal to remember.

The Classic Baked Ziti was great!! My kids and husband loved it. So easy to make. Was great to put together early in the day to have on a busy sport night. Made great left overs too. This one is a keeper. Thanks.

Thanks for the great recipe!  I only had a 26 oz. jar of spaghetti sauce on hand, so I decreased the chicken broth to 1/2 cup, and it was wonderful!  My husband loved it and told me I need to make it again... so it's a keeper!

This turned out really well.  I served it with a nice green salad and fresh bread and my whole family enjoyed it.  I followed the recipe to a "T" and it came out perfectly.  I will definitely make this again.  Thanks for posting, Caryn.

Wow! I would give this recipe 10 stars if I could! It was a very yummy dish and I would not change a thing. I used Prego chunky garden and it turned out awesome. This will be a favorite to make in my house again and again! Thank you!
What more could you ask for:  Taste Great and it's Quick and Easy.  Thanks for the recipe.
This recipie is wonderful! Even my picky toddler finished her plate! I used sweet Italian sausage instead of hamburger. This is going in my dinner rotation! Thanks for posting it!

Absolutely delicious! I used small penne pasta I had on hand instead of the ziti, and added a bit more sauce than called for. (We love LOTS of sauce). Turned out perfect. Eating the leftovers tonight for dinner as well. I just have to make some more homemade garlic bread to go with it! Definitely a keeper! Thanks for posting.

Very good and reasonably easy.  This really makes a lot, I hope I can find the room in the fridge for the leftovers. I don't expect them to stay in there too long though. :)  I used a 28 oz can of spaghetti sauce, and one cups worth of chicken boullion with a cup of water instead of broth.  I think next time I'll use a jar with the full amount.  Judging from my husband's reaction this will definitely be going on dinner rotation.

Delicious! I made this for dinner last night and it was really good! I almost doubled the recipe because it didn't seem like it would make that much but everyone is right, it makes PLEANTY! a really good simple recipe, thank you:)
Excellent recipe- very easy too!  Thanks for sharing!

16 oz of pasta seems like a HUGE amount.  I just put the dish in the oven, and used less than a 16 oz box of pasta, and had nearly an eighth + (2 oz, a medium tupperware dish of rotini) left over.

I'll let you know how it tastes afterward, but if I followed the instructions right there is way too much pasta...

Even though I messed up on a few things (like putting in the whole can of chicken broth instead of just a cup and putting the cheese on top as at the beginning of the cooking time instead of just at the end) it was incredibly delicious! Everyone loved it. Thanks for a recipe I can use regularly because it was so easy and quick to prepare.

Sorry, but I did not like this recipe. I was very interested in using this recipe and followed it with no variation.  But with these ingredients combined it had a taste that was, to me, odd. Perhaps I used a weird & different sauce or somehow botched it up (only human!).
Great recipe - my whole family enjoyed it and I will definitely make it again.

I made this tonight and followed Miller's lead using homemade meat sauce (only kind I had).  I don't know if it was the addition of the chicken stock, but this was just delicious.  I thought that the proportion of sauce/liquid to pasta was perfect, and reducing either would have resulted in a skimpy dish.  I was careful to leave the boiled pasta undercooked so that by the time it came out of the oven it still had some bite to it.  Thank you for a wonderful recipe, we'll make it often!
It was very good.  The only thing I added to It was ricotta cheese and I cooked It a little longer than what It said.

Delicious and easy!  I had 10 family members for dinner and needed something simple and quick because I work full time.  Received many compliments. Even the picky toddlers who don't have long attention spans ate 3 plate-fulls.  Because I like people to eat their fill, I did double the recipe and now have plenty of leftovers for everyone's lunch.  A definite keeper!

My husband and I both thought this was very good. I only made a few changes to the recipe; I added additional garlic, some Italian seasonings, half of a red pepper, and then some red pepper flakes (we tend to like things on the spicy side). Quite tasty!
This dish was OK.  I followed the recipe exactly and it was good but not great.

I made my own meatless sauce the day before and it was a breeze to put together the next evening.I had 7 people for dinner and the two teenagers had two huge helpings.
I served salad and french garlic bread.Someone said in a review that 16 ozs of pasta was to much.
I did not find this to be true,but the right amount.I did have some left over,but this is a plus for me,we love leftovers.Thanks for sharing your recipe it was enjoyed by all :0)

My family and I thought this was a very yummy ziti. The only addition was I added 1/2 lb. Italian sausage. It made the sauce meatier and tasted more "Italian". I served it with salad, fresh bread, and a good ole bottle of wine. It was an easy recipe to prepare and something that I would like to have again. Thanks Caryn.

Very delicious recipe!!  The only changes I made was that I used a tablespoon of chopped fresh oregano leaves from my herb garden and I used "Italian Blend" cheese because it is what I had on hand.  For those who haven't tried it, it is a blend of mozzarella, parmesan, provolone, romano and two others I can't remember.  It worked great!!  Thanks for sharing this recipe.
Everyone loved this, even my picky niece & nephews.  Omitted parmesan and used ricotta instead.  Very easy to make and the whole family loves it.
This was a wonderful meal!  I actually froze half of it afterwards and it was even good reheated!  I will definetly be making this again!

I made this without the meat and definitely missed the flavor.  However, I added a bit of thyme to the sauce as it was simmering, and replaced half the chicken  Merlot for some depth (just personal preference).  The only suggestion I might make is to crank up the heat for the last 10 mins. of uncovered cooking time so that the cheese can brown a little more.  Great recipe!

Made this exactly as listed except I couldn't find Ziti in my supermarket so I used Rigatoni instead.  This recipe was okay but it wasn't anything special imho.  Hubby thought it was just okay too.  We had it with crusty bread only so maybe a salad or some other side might have made it more special however, I probably won't make it again.
Tasty!!!  My family loved this.  I reduced the recipe by half and had plenty to feed 6 of us.  Definitely will make this again!
Very easy to make and everyone loved it!! There were no leftovers! It was very tasty. Thank you!

I simply don't understand how anybody could have any complaints about this dish--it's fantastic, five stars all the way. I'd assign more if I could. I followed the recipe as best I could--pasta sauce is not sold in 32oz jars in Canada but 28oz, so I made up the difference with plain tomato sauce which I seasoned with extra oregano and some thyme--but also added some sliced fresh mushrooms to the meat-onion mixture. This was so easy to prepare, even after I was pooped after a day of xmas shopping, and makes an enormous dish of pasta--enough to generously feed 6, definitely. I was worried it wouldn't fit in the 13x9 pan, but it did. This recipe is a true keeper; I'll be making it often. Thanks for posting this winner!

Wow, this was great.  Last night I made Sharlene ~W's Jo Mama's World Famous Spaghetti #22782.  I used the leftovers for this tonight.  Incredible.  I can see why some people would think that there is too much pasta.  I like my noodles covered in sauce - but my DH who eats a lot more baked ziti than me said it was the perfect the amount of noodles to sauce for this dish.  
This is a great dish and I will be making it again!!

Caryn, thanks for this recipe.  It was simple to make, but tasted like a LOT more effort had gone into the preparation.  I couldn't find Ziti, but Rigatoni is pretty close, so I used that.  And I probably used about half the recommended am't of onion - otherwise, followed the recipe exactly.  And I loved that there is enough for a 2nd meal some night when I'm too pooped to cook.

Yummy! This was my first time making Ziti and we enjoyed it. I only had a 700g jar of sauce (which was about 3 cups) so I had to make up the difference with some canned diced tomatoes. I also had a 900g pkg. of ziti, which I used approx. 1/2 the pkg. which worked out about right as everything fit nicely into the 9x13 in the end. Served with some garlic bread and had a tasty supper. Thanks Caryn!
I thought this was very good.  It does make a large batch therefore we had leftovers for several days.  I definitely will make again (the kids LOVED it!).

Very good!  I cooked this on a spur of the moment and used 16 oz of small lasagna noodles, which is what I had on hand.  Otherwise I followed the directions exactly.  I served with garlic bread and a tossed salad.  Thanks for posting!

This is really good, and easy. I used 4 cups of my homemade sauce, and a 5-cheese "Italian blend" instead of mozzarella, but  otherwise followed exactly. It *fills up* a 13x9 dish for sure. We had 6 for dinner, and had 4 servings leftover. (good reheated, but kinda dry so I added more sauce when I reheated). Served with salad,  French bread with SaraFish's Delicious Cheese Spread #18914 and a good merlot. Thanks!
Great dish, I've even tossed in some pepperon when I had some on hand.  I've been making this for probably a year but for some reason never got around to reviewing it.

This was delicious and so easy! I wanted to make Ziti bake, but didn't have any ricotta and 99% of the Ziti recipes call for Ricotta. We all really enjoyed this. The only thing I did differently was to half the recipe and I used ground Italian Sausage because I had some I wanted to use up. Delicious recipe! Thank you very much for posting it!

I made this for dinner tonight and the only change I made was I used italian sausage instead of the beef.  My sons comment was, "I think I'll have this for my next birthday dinner".  Thank you for posting this recipe, I know I'll be asked to make this one again.

This baked zita was excellent!  I cut the recipe in half since there's only two of us, and we still have enough left for another meal!  I probably had a bit more sauce than I needed, but it was delicious!  This will definitely be a regular item on our menu.  Thanks for sharing Caryn!

Hearty and delicious! 8-10 servings is in no way exaggerated. I fed six of us, a couple of whom are really big eaters, and there was plenty. I added extra garlic, just because it's a favorite here. Thanks for posting!
My family loves this, it is easy to make even after working all day!  I did add some provolone cheese in place of some of the mozzarella and added more crushed garlic.  Fantastic and hearty!

This was sooo good! I am so full I am going to explode- I just couldn't stop eating it! I used 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder because I was out of fresh garlic, and for the pasta sauce I used a 26 ounce jar of Prego's Fresh Mushroom + an 8 ounce can of Hunt's tomato sauce (there were no 32 ounce jars of sauce). Also, I was so pumped to actually find Ziti pasta- it is different than Penne, and Barilla and Creamette don't carry it (at least not at our stores). Instead, I found a package of it in the organic isle. I was very proud to find it! And finally, I used part-skim Mozzarella cheese. The final result was absolutely perfect for what I needed tongiht! I will be making this again and again! Thanks!

Delicious.  I couldn't find a 32 ounce jar of spaghetti sauce so I used a 26 oz. jar plus an 8 oz. can of tomato sauce.  Also used beef broth instead of chicken cause that's what I had on hand.  Turned out great and it's definitely in the rotation at our house now.  Thanks Caryn for sharing.
This was the best Ziti recipe that I have found.  I liked all the parmesan cheese that it had in it.  Very flavorful.  Will be making this again.  Thanks for posting.

Simply wonderful. The only difference that I made was I had a bigger jar of sauce (45 oz). and 1 1/2 lbs. ground beef because that's what dh brought home. It ended up being the perfect amount for the 16 oz. of pasta. We are very pleased and will definetly be having this again.

This has become our favorite simple pasta recipe. I sometimes make changes depending on what's available, and I have started simply mixing the sauce and noodles together first rather than doing all the layers. No matter how closely I follow the recipe though, it is always fabulous! (I never make it if I don't have any broth though--this is the first baked pasta dish I've found that doesn't get too dry, and I'm sure its because of the broth) This is even better reheated the next day! (Is that possible?)

Wow, this was very tasty and easy to put together.  I didn't have any chicken broth so I used beef broth and it tasted great!  Other than that I followed the recipe exactly.  Thanks for posting Caryn, will definetly be making this again.

Absolutely wonderful dish!  My family and I definitely noticed the difference from the regular ziti I used to make.  I used 1 1/3 lbs. of ground chuck (as packaged), 45 oz. of Ragu sauce, 1 1/4 cups of chicken broth, and added a can of mushrooms, along with a touch extra of the spices and I have enough ziti leftover for this evening!  Thanks so much for sharing, Caryn!  This is a keeper!
Followed this recipe exactly.  Not our favorite, but certainly passable.  Might make again, increasing the garlic by quite a lot as we love garlic!
My family and I really enjoyed this recipe.  Thanks for sharing.  I followed exactally as shown.  Next time I will add mushrooms and a little more sauce.  It was just a little dry.

This was very simple and easy, made it as written, but I do have to say, I agree, if time permits, I will try it with homemade sauce, think it would be even better. But for an easy quick meal, this can't be beat. Thanx

This is so easy to throw together!  I  can not believe I have yet to review it.  I agree, that usually I like to use my own sauce, but on those busy nights, jarred is good too. I also like to add some basil.  Thanks for sharing!

This turned out nicely and everyone at my get together gave favorable comments.  The only change I made was that I used italian sausage instead of ground beef.  Thanks for the recipe.  I'll be making it again.

A very good recipe that makes an easy weeknight meal.  As with most pasta dishes, it was much better the next day.  I served with garlic bread and had a good, filling meal.  Thanks for the recipe, Caryn!
Easy, tasty and very good!  I'll make this again and again!
Very good recipe.  I will be making this again.  Thanks for sharing!

Yum yum yum!  This was delicious!  It didn't look like it would make enough but we had leftovers for the next day.  I also added some chili pepper flakes and diced red and green peppers and mushrooms.  It was so good!  Thanks!
This was great. It made sooo much just for my husband and I, so next time I will try and reduce it somehow. But overall, it was great! Definatly a keeper.
Wonderful, Instead of ground beef I did use ground sausage. The whole family loved it. Will be serving again. Thanks!
I made this last weekend and not a week later, I have requests to make it again!!  It's easy!  It's delicious!  What more can I say?  5 stars all the way!!!

This was a delicious dinner! I followed exactly, except used 26 oz spaghetti sauce. It had a great flavor, almost tasted like sausage instead of ground beef. My picky BF loved it and I will be making this easy recipe often, thanks!
Simple, easy to make. Everyone went back for seconds. I followed the recipe exactly as written. Very good.

Great recipe! We had a 28-ounce jar of pasta sauce, so we supplimented with tomato sauce. I also used beef broth because that made more sense to me with hamburger. We also used an Italian cheese mix (package was 2 cups) which was plenty of cheese, so we omitted the 1 cup parmesan.
YUM! What more can be said after 68 reviews? Made as posted and used homemade spaghetti sauce (Recipe #1211; "Spaghetti Sauce to Die For").  Delicious! Thanks for a keeper!

This was really good, and we had a lot of leftovers, I used more sauce than called for and more cheese, the only thing was there were to many noodles, so I think next time I will use less noodles, but this was great.
Perfect combination of ingredients to make a hearty casserole enjoyed by all.
This was way too much pasta for the amount of sauce.  I will try this again, but with about 1/2 of the pasta listed.  I also added salt.  It tasted good, so I will try it again.
This took a lot longer than I had origionally anticipated, but I thought it was worth it.  My son thought it needed more sauce, but my husband and I enjoyed it as is.  Thanks for sharing!
I made this in two 8x8 pans.  One I cooked in the countertop over (it's July!) and the other is going into the freezer.  This recipe is excellent!

YUMMY!!!!  This recipe was awesome!  I made it for my family and also brought it to a potuck (kept it in a crockpot, so it didn't look as pretty but tasted just as great!).  I added a bit of sugar and butter to the sauce (personal taste) Thanks for the great recipe.  Easy to make and so good!

This is a great substitute when you don't have the time to make a lasagna, and it tastes just as good.  My husband went back to several helpings, so I knew it was a keeper.  I halved the recipe, and there was still enough for generous servings.

I've been making this exact recipe for almost 20 years and it is wonderful! Originally found it on the back of a box of Mueller's ziti. It's especially good to take to pot-lucks because it retains its heat so well. This is also one of those recipes that is better when reheated the next day.
Easy and simple to come together. DH and I enjoyed it.  Since it was just us two I halved the recipe and still was plenty lefted over for tomorrow's dinner :)   Thanks for sharing the recipe.
This is very good ziti and now the only was I am going to make it.  I used Italian sausage and gr. beef for more zip.  This got rave reviews from all.

Made this dish for my sister and brother in law tonight.  It was great!  My husband says it was delicious....I added extra garlic.  I had a 27 oz jar of meatless sauce, so I added 5 oz of diced tomatoes to make 32 oz.   I used about 1 1/2  cups of the chicken broth.  I added mushrooms. My family loved this recipe!!!  They couldn't stop eating it.
This was FAB! We had it 2 nights ago and we all loved it. Not hard to prepare and what a treat.  I just found this web site and boy am I glad I did.  This brings new life to our meal time. Thanks

It turned out perfectly! I will make this again, both in the crock pot, and as written!  Thanks for posting!
We really enjoyed this recipe!  I did use italian sausage instead of ground beef and added mushrooms.  Thanks!

We LOVED this.  I used Emeril's kicked up tomato and garlic sauces and it was just the right amount of spice.  We're a family of 4 with a 6 yr old and a 3 yr old and we ate 1/2 of this.  Ziti is hard to find though!
Quick and easy, very tasty.  My whole family enjoyed it!
How can you go wrong? Pasta & cheese, everyone loved it. Thanks!

so good as is. i've also made this using ground turkey and whole wheat penne and it was also fabulous, although i do think i like the taste the ground beef gives it a little better. Thanks for a delicious recipe.

Simple recipe, very good instructions, and the result is very very good comfort food. Thank you for this recipe, it's a sure repeat in our house.
this was good except next time I will leave the oregano out.

My hubby and I loved this!  I only made a few changes: I left out the onion b/c we don't like onion and added mushrooms.  I also didn't cover it and added cheese on top before putting it in the oven b/c we like the cheese on top crunchy! I will definately make this again!

My family loved this!! Had this with a nice salad and garlic bread.

My family really liked this. Next time I make this I may use Sherri H., suggestion and use cottage cheese instead or add more pasta sauce; because it was a bit dry. I also used basil instead of parsley (all I had available). Great flavor. Thanks for posting.

Easy and tasty! This is a keeper. The only thing I did differently was to throw in some fresh basil I have growing on my deck. I did use the ricotta because I happen to prefer it to cottage cheese although I know other cooks have a preference for the cottage cheese.

awesome....

This is an easy and excellent recipe, although I'll probably add more sauce when I reheat it.  I won't bother making time-consuming lasagna anymore - this satisfies my deepest Italian cravings.  Thanks!
Very easy to make and delicious! Next time I will use more pasta sauce as mine turned out a little dry at the top.
Made this for dinner tonight. Very easy and good. Will be adding this to our regular menu.
Excellent!  I made half a recipe but using my own sauce.  It was quick to put together and flavor was great.

Very good

Wow!  Great recipe!  I used homemade pasta sauce and threw in some fresh oregano from my herb garden.  Great flavor and very authentic!
Very good ziti. My whole family loved it and asked when we are going to have it again.

I used my own sauce, added fresh basil and hot Italian bulk sausage along with cottage cheese instead of ricotta. My husband all but licked his plate and requested I put some of the remaining in small containers so he could nuke it for lunches.

All I have to say is "Yummy in the Tummy"!  I made this last night for Christmas Eve at my sister's home, and everyone loved it! Great Recipe!!
This was good but didn't love it.

This received my DH's approval as a keeper recipe (I let him think he has a choice ;0) I added about 1 1/2 cloves of minced garlic to ricotta and used 4 1/2 c of recipe #22782 sauce, it already has sausage in it and the amount of sauce/sausage was perfect. This was yummy!  I added 1 lg. garlic clove crushed, italian seasoning, and crushed red pepper to the sausage just for some extra kick.  Both my husband and I loved it :-) Thanks!
This is amazing!  Other baked zitis are tasty, but none compare to this recipe.  My family loves it.  It's a hit whenever I take it to potlucks.  I am frequently asked for the recipe.

Very good recipe and easy!  Made a lot and it warmed up well the next day.  Thanks!

So delicious! I added Italian Seasoning and minced garlic like another reviewer mentioned. I will definitely make this again :)

this was great. my husband who doesn't like pasta that much LOVED it!  I used prego with meat sauce, subed the sausage for ground beef & cooked that with 2 tablespoons of minced garlic.  this is a keeper

if i could, i would give this 10 stars. we like it spicy so i used hot italian sausage and added some additional red pepper flake. i also covered it with saran and aluminum foils for most of the cooking time and removed it for the last few minutes under a broiler to brown the top. just don't cheap on the marinara sauce, it definitely makes or breaks this dish.

YUM!   I did tweak it to bulk up the veggie intake, but this was really tasty.  First, I used sweet turkey Italian sausage since my store didn't have the hot.  I added an onion, 3 garlic cloves, fresh mushrooms, 1/2 tsp. crushed red pepper, 1/2 tsp. dried oregano, and 1/2 tsp dried basil to the sausage while browning.  I dumped 1 & 1/2 jars of our favorite sauce before I read to keep them separate, and added 1/2 cup red wine to the red meat sauce mixture.  I used fat free ricotta and added a thawed/drained box of chopped spinach, salt, and pepper to the ricotta mixture.  My last change was to add whole wheat noodle to the whole thing.  I held back some of the red meat sauce I made and put this on top.   DH went back for seconds, and has packed some to take to work tomorrow. I love recipes that give me the basics so I can play.    I might even go meatless with this for our Meatless Mondays  :)

How anyone can rate this below 5 stars is beyond me. It was simple and delicious. I am wishing that we had some leftovers but this all vanished. This will definitely go into regular rotation in our house. Thanks so much for posting!

This was incredibly easy to make and soooo good! I ended up using chicken Italian sausage, but it still came out wonderfully. Fantastic recipe and I'll definitely make again!
This recipe is AMAZING!! I have used recipes on this site for years and this one is by far my favorite. Thanks for the recipe. I made it as written and it was perfect!

We have made this 3 times already! So easy and delicious! We added a can of mushrooms, olives, and sauteed chunks of zucchini and onions and doubled the sauce on the second and third tries, as the first time was a little dry with all the added veggies. So yummy! Will make again and again!

Very Good!!! We loved this!  I made a lot of changes though, but great recipe all the same, thanks for the inspiration!
Yummy! The entire family loved this recipe. It's a keeper.
Yummy! You can really taste the ricotta, and I like that! I added some extra veggies too, like roasted red peppers and mushrooms. Cheesy in many respects, and delicious!

This was a good basic ziti recipe.  It was cheesy and creamy and easy!  I left out the meat and added sauteed mushrooms and cauliflower.  Turned out great except next time I'll season the parts a little more.  Thanks for the great recipe S in PA...

This is good and it is easy. I did add things like other reviewers did like italian seasoning, garlic, and red pepper flakes to the meat. That being said, I didn't have enough italian sausage (hot) so I used some ground beef but since I like spicy the additions added some umph. I will make again.
Ok, so I wasn't impressed by this but my family really enjoyed it.  So they beat me out for a 4 star rating.  I guess I am just used to my mom's recipe for baked ziti.
